title: Using Fronted Adverbials in a Text

instruction.text: Read the story below and choose the fronted adverbial that would fit best in the gap.

atoms.b: ((++Last_month, Once_per_week, Anxiously,)) something amazing happened to Monica as she was on a walk.
((++Each_week, Next_year, Just_then,)) Monica would go on walks through the beautiful countryside, but this one was like no other.
((++All_of_a_sudden, Above_the_clouds, Frantically,)) as Monica was peacefully admiring the scenery, a beautiful ginger cat appeared out of the bushes.
((++Unexpectedly, Outside, Day_by_day,)) the cat began to speak to Monica.
((++Completely_exhausted, Once, Often,)) the cat explained that he had been chased by some scary animals, and that he needed help.
((++Somewhat_flustered, Slowly, Regularly,)) Monica decided to help the cat and bring him home.
((++Carefully, Mysteriously, Sometimes,)) Monica scooped him up, and they began the long walk through the cold countryside back to Monica’s house.
((++Before_long, Always, Last_month,)) they had arrived at Monica’s beautiful countryside cottage, where her mum was waiting for them with a freshly baked pie.
((++In_the_blink_of_an_eye, Beforehand, Rarely,)) the ginger cat had eaten all of the pie and had fallen into a deep sleep by the fireplace.
((++Happily, North_of_here, Never_before,)) Monica and her mum laughed and decided to keep the cat forever.
